response:
It sounds like you are going through a really painful time. Turning forty can bring up heavy emotions, especially when your life doesn't look the way you hoped and you are feeling the weight of being single. It is completely understandable to feel disappointed and to look for ways to escape those feelings. 

However, your current coping methods are putting your health at serious risk. While the pill prevents pregnancy, it does not protect against sexually transmitted infections. Unfortunately, asking someone if they are disease-free is not reliable, as many people carry infections without knowing it. Please consider reaching out to a healthcare provider to get tested and to discuss your sexual health. It could also be very helpful to speak with a therapist who can support you in navigating these difficult feelings about your life and help you find safer ways to cope. You deserve to feel safe, healthy, and to find genuine happiness.
